$sample.title: Journey Whiteboard · its own journey
$sample.note: Real records from the board's own space, as cached on 2026-10-20. Created stamps are as recorded.

rows.label: Items with kinds and statuses; questions carry paths; choosing a path records a decision
A thread on every item: challenge, support, input, answer, and "Ask Claude to weigh in"
Two Claude lanes: quick in the page, deep to the Claude Code session
MoSCoW board with drag, and a background estimate on entering Must, Should or Could
Pages of any type, drafted by Claude from the items they come from
Canvases: pen, highlighter, shapes, bound arrows, text, stickies and cards of items or pages
Spaces: new, clone, save as template, reset, export and import JSON
One more link, "about": questions, tasks and decisions hang under the move they shape
Tree view: problem → move → question → path → decision → page
Move preview, and a dry run that shows any proposal on the tree before it lands
"What about another way?" box on every node
Guide with Claude: six stages from nothing to written outcomes

cols.label: The owner could not see how the hub gets installed and updated
v1 had no way to answer a question, see its paths, challenge or add input
No fast chat-and-iterate loop from the board itself
Work entering the plan was not estimated
Not a whiteboard: no place to write, diagram or paint
It had to outlive one session
No tree of the journey: problems, branches, paths, decisions
Clicking a move showed no preview of its problems, the move, and what it changes
No way to say "what about this other way?" and see the impact first
The eventhub journey was traced by hand; a new one has no fast path
